content.text:
I can't see what you have planned for tomorrow (Thursday, 19 March). This connection uses a Garmin Personal API key, and that kind of key doesn't give access to your training calendar or scheduled workouts. So the empty "tomorrow" field doesn't mean you have nothing planned. I just can't read your schedule.

To find tomorrow's workout:
- **Garmin Connect app:** go to Training & Planning → Training Plans / Calendar.
- **Your watch:** open the Calendar or Training widget.
- **Garmin Coach or another plan you follow** (TrainingPeaks, Runna, etc.): check that app.

If you tell me what's on the schedule, I can help you prepare. I can also look at your recent workouts and weekly totals, which I do have access to, to check whether tomorrow's session fits with how hard you've been training lately.
